text:
alyssa: Quick async update — warmup canary rolling now (slice: warmup-v2). Pushed FF toggle `feature/warmup_v2` to 2% traffic. Please monitor latency + errors. Link: https://console.redwood.local/rollouts/warmup-v2 :rocket:
deploy-bot: Canary started for warmup-v2 on prod-us-east-1 · slice=warmup-v2 · pct=2% · commit=3a4f2d · watch: latency, error-rate, p50_token_time :white_check_mark:
Sam: On it — I'll watch the latency dashboards. Any DB migration or schema changes? @maria
maria: No DB migration for this change, just a feature flag flip + small config tweak. Validated schema locally. No blockers from infra side.
leo: Quick note — seeing a small p95 spike for a subset (~1200ms) on some requests, looks correlated with long-context prompts. Sampling traces now.
alyssa: Thanks @leo. Our rollback criteria: error-rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m OR p95 > 2s for 5m. Also auto-abort if queue latency > 300ms. Agree?
ops: Agreed on criteria. Also abort if token-generation errors spike > 0.3%.
sam: Can we enable extra short-lived debug logging for the affected slice? Suggest `warmup.debug=trace-sample` for 10m.
alyssa: I'll flip that flag in a minute. Using the console API: `curl -X POST https://console.redwood.local/api/flags -d '{"feature":"warmup.debug","value":"trace-sample","ttl":"10m"}'`
deploy-bot: Flag toggle applied · warmup.debug=trace-sample (ttl=10m) · actor=alyssa
leo: Added quick filter in the ingestion pipeline — found 6 traces with KV cache misses and long tokenization: ```json
{"req_id":"r-43","kv_miss":true,"tokens":512}
```
maria: Noted. Those are likely partner-X long prompts. I'll add a defensive tokenizer early-return for >1024 tokens to reduce tail. Pushing a tiny patch to staging.
alyssa: Good. If we hit rollback criteria I'll cut the FF to 0% and revert the canary commit. Keep posting any anomalies here. :eyes:
sam: LGTM. I'll keep an eye on SLO alerting and forward any pager dings. :thumbsup:
ops: SLOs green so far across regions, no escalation.
alyssa: Thanks team — check-in again in ~20m or sooner if thresholds are hit.
